findings.renderer: Pinned IsaacRtxRenderer constructor applies global settings and, when deterministic, explicitly resets /rtx/rendermode to RealTimePathTracing. A process-local experiment selector after constructor completion is required before RenderProducts initialize. MinimalRendering and /rtx/minimal/mode=2 are pinned supported settings.
findings.xr_quality: Pinned XR experience already requests persistent XR AR renderQuality=performance; effective readback must establish any contrast.
findings.xr_foveation: Pinned XR core AR default is warped. UI supports none, inset, warped for non-quadview; actual profile/persistent/foveation/mode must be read back. No custom foveation is implemented.
findings.state_capture: Local ExplicitFrameSampler batches Fabric world poses for the two articulations, two dynamic objects and three camera prims in one XformPrim.get_world_poses call; it copies every field before causal commit. Local native state factory also reads two joint tensors. Pose batch avoids per-recordable world-pose calls.
findings.viewport_image: Pinned omni.kit.viewport.utility.capture_viewport_to_file schedules a desktop viewport capture. Such an image is not physical headset quality evidence.
findings.hdf: Local LiveRecording accepts flush_every_frames (default 64) and terminal close finalizes; experiment changes only the passed interval.

reuse_ladder: Pinned upstream settings and recorder configuration, then process-local thin adapter; no renderer, XR protocol, recorder or robotics framework replacement.
environment_impact: No pinned package, driver or production config change.

mandatory_upstream_audit.processor_config_adapter_required: Opt-in camera_audit process hook and launch selectors only; no label processor, canonical config or runtime default change
